text:
Plate is about 26 cm. The rice salad (red/brown rice with greens, carrot, pineapple, garlic) covers roughly 10×13 cm in a moderate layer, about 150 g at roughly 150 kcal. The corn is two short cob pieces, about 120 g with the cob and about 70 g edible, roughly 70 kcal. Allowing some oil in the salad adds about 40 kcal.
